Audio Overload SDK 1.4.8 as modified by the DeaDBeeF project (reentrant engines),
from https://github.com/DeaDBeeF-Player/deadbeef/tree/master/plugins/psf/aosdk

Chippy's change: psfmain.c no longer includes DeaDBeeF's headers; ao_get_lib
is provided by crates/aosdk-sys.
eng_psf.c, eng_psf2.c: the SPU no longer stops or fades at the tagged length; Chippy does.
